parsed.note_claim: Similar stories about gay couples being jailed until pregnancy in Uganda have been debunked as fabricated.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: There is no evidence to validate the claim that President Museveni of Uganda said a jailed gay couple will be released only when one gets pregnant. Thus, the claim is FALSE.
parsed.reason: The page is a fact-check article that explicitly debunks the narrative of gay men being jailed until pregnancy in Uganda, substantiating the note's assertion that such stories are fabricated.
